info.description: Production REST API for LUXE Algerian E-Commerce Storefront & Tauri 2 Desktop CMS
info.title: Mus Luxury (LUXE) E-Commerce API

get.description: Excel-ready CSV of the Comptabilité tab being viewed.

Compte de résultat since the shop opened, BOTH channels:
  revenue  = online merchandise + delivery fees + in-store sales − in-store refunds
  COGS     = units sold × purchase cost (variant cost, else product cost)
  gross    = revenue − COGS;  net = gross − operating expenses (paid or
             not) − stock losses (write-offs, count gaps, at cost)
Online sales = orders neither cancelled nor returned (a returned COD parcel
was never paid). Same rules as the business dashboard and sales report.
Returns unit margins, markups, total sales and total profits generated by each product.
Distinct actions and entity types for building the filter UI (last ~5000 rows).

post.description:
First-Time Provisioning Endpoint:
Allows the store owner to configure their username, email, password, primary recovery WhatsApp number,
and a second emergency phone number.
SECURITY LOCKOUT: Once called and saved to PostgreSQL, this endpoint is PERMANENTLY LOCKED (HTTP 403).
Even if the CMS application starts on another PC, it detects system_initialized = true
and goes straight to the normal Login & Forgot Password screen.

get.description:

get.description: Every standard section, with its saved state (visible + order) or the default.

Newest orders first. `q` finds any order, however old: order number,
phone (spaces ignored) or customer name (a customer calling about an order
from months ago is not in the newest 100).

Delivery note (bon de livraison): shipping-focused document without any
financial detail beyond COD amount. Handed to the courier / stapled on the
parcel so the recipient can verify their items match.

Everything created / updated since `since`. Variants that went inactive
arrive with `deleted: true`; products with `deleted_at` ditto. The mirror
is forward-only — the client never re-asks for a cursor it already saw.

get.description:
Full catalog dump — call this once, then prefer `/catalog/deltas`.

The cursor returned is `now + 1s`. Snapshot captures everything through
the current second; the next delta starts at the next second, so no row
is double-fetched and no row is missed at the boundary (the trigger
stamps updated_at in whole seconds).
Resolve a scanned barcode / typed SKU to a variant, or fall back to a name/SKU search.

Formal invoice payload (as opposed to the compact receipt): includes the
full boutique legal identity, line-item breakdown with unit prices and VAT,
and the customer record when attached. The CMS renders this as an A4 page
the owner prints on a regular printer for business customers.

delete.description:
Archive (default) or permanently delete a product.

A product that has ANY history — sold online, sold in store, bought from a
supplier — can only be archived: deleting it would change past invoices,
reports and supplier accounts. Customer orders are never deleted here.
`force` is accepted for compatibility and ignored.
delete.summary: Admin Safe Delete Or Archive Product

put.description:
Enforces optimistic concurrency control (`expected_version`) so simultaneous CMS edits
never silently overwrite newer server data (Section 9).

get.description:
A4 purchase order document (bon de commande fournisseur): full supplier
identity, boutique header, itemised table with quantities ordered vs
received, and the money/payment summary.

Returns the exact label batch to print for a PO: one entry per variant,
with `copies` set to the quantity received (or ordered if nothing received
yet). The Desktop CMS pipes this straight into `pos_print_labels` after a
PO is receipted so every unit that just arrived gets a sticky barcode.

Variants without a barcode are returned with `barcode: null`; the UI must
assign one (generate internal or scan the supplier's) before printing.

post.description:
Records arrival of purchased goods:
1. Increments variant inventory.
2. Logs inventory movement.
3. Recomputes Weighted Average Cost (PMP) for products.
4. Updates supplier balance liability.
5. Posts balanced double-entry accounting ledger: Debit 3000 (Stock) / Credit 4010 (Fournisseurs).

Cryptographically signed administrative endpoint:
Enforces HMAC-SHA256 signature verification over (method, path, timestamp, nonce, body_sha256).
Rejects any replay attacks, expired timestamps, or tampered payloads.

get.description:
Automatic Reconnection & Delta Synchronization Endpoint for the Tauri 2 Desktop CMS.
When the owner turns their Windows PC back on (or reconnects to the internet),
the Desktop CMS calls this endpoint to immediately fetch all new guest orders,
updated stock quantities, and inventory movements recorded by the 24/7 VPS while the PC was off.

The owner's desktop CMS keeps a copy of each backup on the shop PC (the
VPS disk is small). Owner only, encrypted files only, written to the
audit log.

Owner only: which .env settings are set, missing or for features not
built — secret values are never returned (app/settings.py).

What the installed CMS asks every few hours. 204 = nothing published yet
(the updater reads it as "no update").

A versioned installer or its signature. Only those two kinds of name are
served, so nothing else in the folder (or outside it) can be reached.

Real-time server-side calculator for the Storefront Cart & Checkout:
Returns the exact admin-configured Home or Stop-Desk delivery fee for the chosen Wilaya,
plus the discount and final total in DA.

Public guest order tracking requiring BOTH order_reference and matching customer phone
to prevent IDOR enumeration of other customers' orders.

POS / Desktop CMS version-compatibility probe.

Returns the minimum supported POS version, the latest released POS
version, and a boolean telling the client whether its own version is
still allowed to talk to this API. Backwards-compatible by design: adding
a new field here must never break an older POS.

Returns the complete storefront configuration controlled by the Desktop CMS:
settings, active homepage sections, active banners, and active categories.

Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Webhook Verification Endpoint (GET).
C-3.4: Returns 503 when WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN is empty/unconfigured.

post.description:
Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Webhook Receiver (POST) for message delivery & read receipts (H-4).
- Enforces per-IP rate limiting.
- Returns 503 if WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is not configured.
- Caps payload size at 64 KB and statuses logged per request at 50.
- Always requires a valid HMAC-SHA256 X-Hub-Signature-256 header.
